closeout.reason: The managed-product availability slice is implemented, verified, exact-head reviewed, proof-published, explicitly sponsored as a bounded pilot, and merged by the maintainer.
closeout.summary: Accepted template-store as the neutral dogfood surface; proved EmDash plus Blocks plus Commerce managed-SKU identity plus Inventory 8-to-5-to-8 availability on desktop and mobile; adopted the XAPI-568 repository/verifier contract; kept SmokyClub untouched; published immutable PR evidence; recorded the temporary source-alias and disposable proof-adapter compatibility risk as an explicitly sponsored non-production pilot; delivered through template-store PR #3 and human merge commit 4bc9122b67f580b6ef7564bfbe81f8785aab52a0. No deploy, package publication, production mutation, or agent merge occurred.

current_focus.domain: Blocks, Commerce, and Inventory storefront availability vertical
current_focus.summary: Build the managed-product availability vertical in dinkuskit/template-store only: a neutral Astro/EmDash storefront composed with Blocks and wired through the current public Commerce and Inventory contracts, with change-and-restore browser proof. Preserve SmokyClub as reference-only and exclude cart, checkout, payments, shipping, deploy, publish, merge, and production mutation.
